message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build

permissions:
  id-token: write

on: [workflow_dispatch, push, pull_request]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: coady/pylucene
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
    - name: Cache uv dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/uv
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-uv-
    - run: uv venv --system-site-packages
    - run: make check
    - run: uv run coverage xml
    - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
      with:
        use_oidc: true

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
    - name: Cache uv dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/uv
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-uv-
    - run: make lint

  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: coady/pylucene
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
    - name: Cache uv dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/uv
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-uv-
    - run: apt-get install -y jq sudo
    - uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2
    - run: uv venv --system-site-packages
    - run: make html",
  "rationale": "Add a uv dependency cache (~/.cache/uv) keyed on pyproject.toml/uv.lock to every job that invokes uv (test, lint, docs). This preserves all existing build/test/lint/docs steps and coverage while avoiding repeated dependency downloads on reruns. It matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads; modest VM-time benefit) and the measured dependency-cache experiment (~9.2% elapsed savings). No permissions are weakened, and no secrets, deployment/publishing, privileged actions, or new network access are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
